instruction: Put the red pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
red_pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
green_case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

# Find grasp candidate with fingers along short axis (perpendicular to long axis) at center height
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - (red_pen["long_axis_yaw"] + 3.1416/2)) < 0.1 and abs(c["height"] - 0.006) < 0.005:
        best_candidate = c
        break

grasp(best_candidate)

# Find free spot in green_case with correct orientation
spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")["spots"]
if not spots:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots[0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=green_case["long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
